title: A named tint swatch next to a local tint
concept: A <Tint> swatch with BaseColor and TintValue is a colour at reduced strength with a name of its own; FillTint applies the same reduction to one object only.

annotations.note: The base colour: a process CMYK vermilion, 0 85 90 5.

A named tint is its own element, <Tint>, not an attribute on <Color>. BaseColor names the colour it is a tint of and TintValue the strength in percent. The channel values repeat the base's, as InDesign writes them.
